$doc: Review configuration for MTK. Controls confidence thresholds and verdict rules across pre-commit-review, code-review-and-quality, and compliance-reviewer. See .claude/references/review-finding-schema.md. Per-engineer overrides go in .claude/review-config.local.json (gitignored).

decision_origin.$doc: When true, reviewer findings and learnings entries must carry a decision_origin field. Enforced by scripts/learnings.sh add and by review-output validators.

sycophancy_index.$doc: π = approved / (approved + modified + rejected) over the last window_days. Status flips to warn when pi >= warn_threshold. Surfaced by toolkit-health and scripts/learnings.sh metrics.
